form.official-title: To amend the charter of the Future Farmers of America, and for other purposes.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the National FFA Organization's Federal Charter Amendments Act.
Section 70901 of title 36, United States Code, is amended—

paragraph.text: in subsection (a), by striking corporation and inserting FFA; and
in subsection (b), by striking corporation and inserting FFA.

section.text: Section 70902 of title 36, United States Code, is amended—

paragraph.text: in the matter preceding paragraph (1), by striking corporation and inserting FFA;
by redesignating paragraphs (1) and (2) as paragraphs (7) and (8), respectively;
by striking paragraphs (3), (4), (6), and (7);
by redesignating paragraph (5) as paragraph (11);
by redesignating paragraphs (8) and (9) as paragraphs (12) and (13), respectively;
by inserting before paragraph (7), as redesignated by paragraph (2), the following:
to be an integral component of instruction in agricultural education, including instruction relating to agriculture, food, and natural resources;
to advance comprehensive agricultural education in the United States, including in public schools, by supporting contextual classroom and laboratory instruction and work-based experiential learning;

to prepare students for successful entry into productive careers in fields relating to agriculture, food, and natural resources, including by connecting students to relevant postsecondary educational pathways and focusing on the complete delivery of classroom and laboratory instruction, work-based experiential learning, and leadership development;
to be a resource and support organization that does not select, control, or supervise State association, local chapter, or individual member activities;
to develop educational materials, programs, services, and events as a service to State and local agricultural education agencies;
to seek and promote inclusion and diversity in its membership, leadership, and staff to reflect the belief of the FFA in the value of all human beings;
in paragraph (7), as redesignated by paragraph (2)—

subparagraph.text: by striking composed of students and former students of vocational agriculture in public schools qualifying for Federal reimbursement under the Smith-Hughes Vocational Education Act (20 U.S.C. 11–15, 16–28; and
by inserting as such chapters and associations carry out agricultural education programs that are approved by States, territories, or possessions after United States;

paragraph.text: in paragraph (8), as redesignated by paragraph (2)—

subparagraph.text: by striking to develop and inserting to build;
by striking train for useful citizenship, and foster patriotism, and thereby and inserting and; and
by striking aggressive rural and and inserting assertive;

paragraph.text: by inserting after paragraph (8), as redesignated by paragraph (2), the following:
to increase awareness of the global and technological importance of agriculture, food, and natural resources, and the way agriculture contributes to our well-being;
to promote the intelligent choice and establishment of a career in fields relating to agriculture, food, and natural resources;
in paragraph (11), as redesignated by paragraph (4)—

subparagraph.text: by striking to procure for and distribute to State and inserting to make available to State;
by inserting , programs, services, before and equipment; and
by striking corporation and inserting FFA;

paragraph.text: in paragraph (12), as redesignated by paragraph (5), by striking State boards for vocational and inserting State boards and officials for career and technical; and
in paragraph (13), as redesignated by paragraph (5), by striking corporation and inserting FFA.

section.text: Section 70904 of title 36, United States Code, is amended—

paragraph.text: in subsection (a)—

subparagraph.text: in paragraph (1), by striking corporation and inserting FFA each place the term appears;
by striking paragraphs (2) and (3) and inserting the following:

paragraph.text: The board—

subparagraph.text: shall consist of—

clause.text: the Secretary of Education, or the Secretary of Education's designee who has experience in agricultural education, the FFA, or career and technical education; and

subclause.text: representing the fields of education, agriculture, food, and natural resources; or
with experience working closely with the FFA; and

subparagraph.text: shall not include any individual who is a current employee of the National FFA Organization.

paragraph.text: The number of directors, terms of office of the directors, and the method of selecting the directors, are as provided in the constitution or bylaws of the FFA.

subparagraph.text: in paragraph (4)—

clause.text: in the first sentence, by striking bylaws and inserting constitution or bylaws of the FFA; and
in the third sentence, by striking “chairman” and inserting chair;

paragraph.text: by striking subsection (b); and
by inserting after subsection (a) the following:

subsection.text: The officers of the FFA, the terms of officers, and the election of officers, are as provided in the constitution or bylaws of the FFA, except that such officers shall include—

paragraph.text: a national advisor;
an executive secretary; and
a treasurer.

The board may designate a governing committee. The terms and method of selecting the governing committee members are as provided in the constitution or bylaws of the FFA, except that all members of the governing committee shall be members of the board of directors and at all times the governing committee shall be comprised of not less than 3 individuals.

When the board is not in session, the governing committee has the powers of the board subject to the board’s direction and may authorize the seal of the FFA to be affixed to all papers that require it.
The board shall designate to such committee—

subparagraph.text: the chair of the board;
the executive secretary of the board; and
the treasurer of the board.

subsection.text: There shall be not less than 6 national student officers of the FFA, including a student president, 4 student vice presidents (each representing regions as provided in the constitution or bylaws of the corporation), and a student secretary.

paragraph.text: by striking subsection (b);
by redesignating subsections (c) and (d) as subsections (b) and (c), respectively; and
in subsection (b), as so redesignated, by striking , except that and all that follows through (20 U.S.C. 11–15, 16–28).

section.text: Section 70909 of title 36, United States Code, is amended to read as follows:

subsection.text: On request of the board of directors, the FFA may collaborate with Federal agencies, including the Department of Education and the Department of Agriculture on matters of mutual interest and benefit.
Those Federal agencies may make personnel, services, and facilities available to administer or assist in the administration of the activities of the FFA.

Personnel of the Federal agencies may not receive compensation from the FFA for their services, except that travel and other legitimate expenses as defined by the Federal agencies and approved by the board may be paid.
The Federal agencies also may cooperate with State boards and other organizations for career and technical education to assist in the promotion of activities of the FFA.
